name: Shen Zui Jiang Lin
original_name: 神罪降临 Uberich: Advent Sinners
source:
In the middle of September, the Horiverti Residence in the suburban hills suddenly bustled with energy.

The owners of the villa, the Hartson sisters, saved a boy and a girl from a dark alley. The boy, Joe, could only remember being attacked by an elusive shadow while Raina, the girl and Joe's ex-girlfriend, simply wanted Joe to disappear.

Suddenly, a strange woman in a long, stifling black dress broke into the house. Without hesitation, she released a wave of unidentifiable energy bullets and everyone immediately descended into a confused chaos. Luckily, a woman who called herself Annie came to the rescue.

Annie urged everyone to sneak into the enja Defense Science Institute to find out what had happened but Joe, still clueless, had lost all interest. However, Annie later found a tracker on Joe's body and started to become suspicious of him. Only then did Joe realize there was no way he could stay out of this mess.

In the basement computer lab of the so-called enja Defense Science Institute building, the group uncovers a horrifying secret...

What do the elusive shadow, the tracker, the mysterious woman, a horrifying tunnel, Raina's late father, the supervision in the dark, an assassin, haunted ruins, a space blockade, a thing under the floor, a Space-based Kinetic Bombardment System, a high-track circular-orbit space station, Creators, Power Words, powers from the External, GS, religious wars, and the organization that only seems to exist in Annie's words have anything to do with Joe? What occurred before everything started? When these seemingly irrelevant pieces come together, what kind of future will it create for the world?

The once-deserted Horiverti Residence is becoming eerily lively.

[From [url=https://www.uberich-adventsinners.com/en-story]official website[/url]]
translation:
九月中旬，位于郊区山上的霍里维蒂住宅突然热闹起来。

别墅的主人哈特森姐妹从黑暗的小巷里救了一个男孩和一个女孩。男孩乔只记得被一个难以捉摸的影子袭击，而女孩雷娜，乔的前女友，只是想让乔消失。

突然，一个穿着令人窒息的黑色长裙的陌生女人闯进了屋子。她毫不犹豫地释放出一波无法辨认的能量弹，所有人顿时陷入了一片混乱。幸运的是，一位自称安妮的女士出手相救。

安妮催促大家潜入恩加国防科学研究所，看看到底发生了什么事，但依然一无所知的乔已经失去了兴趣。然而，安妮后来在乔的身上发现了一个追踪器，并开始对他产生怀疑。直到那时，乔才意识到他无法置身于这场混乱之中。

在所谓的恩贾国防科学研究所大楼的地下室计算机实验室中，小组发现了一个可怕的秘密……

难以捉摸的影子、追踪者、神秘的女人、恐怖的隧道、雷娜已故的父亲、黑暗中的监管、刺客、闹鬼的废墟、空间封锁、地板下的东西、天基动能轰炸系统、高轨道圆形轨道空间站、创造者、真言、来自外部的力量、GS、宗教战争、以及似乎只存在于安妮文字中的组织有什么关系呢？和乔?一切开始之前发生了什么？当这些看似无关的碎片组合在一起时，将为世界创造什么样的未来？

曾经荒芜的霍里维蒂住宅现在变得异常热闹。
